name: ION Solar
old_description: “I have been thinking about getting solar for about 4 years. While working in the yard one day last year, a young man stopped and chatted about solar panels. He set me up with one of their sales people. On the appointed day Mitch Gresalfi showed up and we talked for over 2 hours. He provided a lot of info and he answered every question I had. To this day I haven't regretted installing the panels. My electric bills stayed the same for the first few months, ($250-$300), then they started to go down. My last bill was $0. Yes they will fluctuate throughout the year, but I am very happy with my decision.”
about:
ION Solar is headquartered in Ashland, Virginia, and operates as a residential solar installation company serving homeowners across the United States. The company does not disclose its founding year, ownership structure, or founders in the provided materials.

The company provides a full-service solar installation process that begins with an on-site home assessment, followed by custom system design by an in-house engineering team, handling of permits and approvals, and final installation and activation. ION Solar manages financing, design, permitting, and installation, using Tier 1 solar panels, MLPE microinverters, and Tesla Powerwall 3 battery storage. To date, the company reports more than 85,000 completed installations nationwide.

ION Solar serves residential customers, with testimonials from homeowners in Virginia and other states highlighting reduced electricity bills and positive installation experiences. The company also references Solar Renewable Energy Certificates and roofing-related services, indicating a focus on residential renewable energy and home energy efficiency.

ION Solar differentiates itself through a “worry-free, done-for-you service” model that includes dedicated project coordinators, weekly check-ins, and a 10-year workmanship guarantee alongside industry-leading 25-year product and 30-year power output warranties on panels. The company states its mission is to deliver a premium product and premium experience, backed by a satisfaction guarantee.
